'''Macu''' was a [[Seanchan]] ''[[morat'raken]]''.

== Activities ==
She was investigating a large group of [[Kin]]s woman and [[Sea Folk]] at the [[Kin]]'s farm just outside [[Ebou Dar]], when she was killed by a fireball.
